What we know on day 1,634 Warren Murray with Guardian writers and agencies Thu 13 Aug 2026 22.05 EDT Last modified on Thu 13 Aug 2026 22.07 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google A Russian military officer labelled as a Ukrainian defector ⁠was killed in a ⁠bomb ​attack on Thursday in Russian-annexed Crimea. Robert Shageyev was described on Russian Telegram channels as ‌a former Ukrainian naval officer who switched allegiance to ‌Russia during Moscow’s annexation of Crimea in 2014 when he was commanding Ukraine’s only submarine, the Zaporizhzhia . Myrotvorets – a Ukrainian website keeping a database of people described as war criminals or ‌traitors – said Shageyev had been “liquidated”. The attack took place in Sevastopol, the biggest city in Russian-annexed Crimea. ​The regional governor, Mikhail Razvozhayev, said a woman was arrested on suspicion of ⁠assassinating Shageyev on behalf of Ukrainian special services. State news agency TASS quoted the FSB security service as saying the arrested woman was ⁠a Russian national. There was no immediate comment ⁠from Ukraine. Separately, Razvozhayev said four Russian explosives experts and a security guard were killed in Sevastopol while trying to dispose of an explosive device. A Russian drone attack on a passenger train killed two people , Ukrainian officials said. “Today in the Odesa region, the Russians once again destroyed an ordinary passenger train locomotive with a jet-powered drone. There were 340 people on the train,” said the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, on Thursday. “Whoever was operating that drone certainly could not have been unaware that the target was entirely civilian,” he added. The dead were the train’s engineer and assistant engineer, officials said. An oil refinery in the Russian city ⁠of Orsk that was hit by Ukrainian drones has been forced ⁠to shut down ⁠completely , the regional governor said on Thursday. “Shrapnel damaged key infrastructure that cannot currently be repaired. The equipment is imported, and due to sanctions, repairs could ⁠take up to six months,” said Yevgeny ​Solntsev, governor of the ‌surrounding Orenburg region. The Ukrainian military said on Tuesday ​it had attacked ​the Orsk refinery near ​the border with Kazakhstan about 1,470km (915 miles) south-east ​of Moscow. A Russian plan to kill a Ukrainian American citizen in Warsaw was thwarted , the Polish prime minister said. Donald Tusk said it was the first time that “someone on the order of Russia” had sought to attack a US citizen on the territory of another Nato country . The suspect, allegedly recruited by Russia’s secret services, was detained by Polish authorities on 7 August. The American Ukrainian citizen “was uncomfortable for the Putin regime”, Tusk said. The Russian foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The US state department said it was aware of the reports but had no additional information. Russian plot to kill Ukrainian American thwarted in Warsaw, says Polish PM Read more Ukraine has proposed a deal with Russia for both sides to halt their attacks on civilian ships in the Black Sea in an apparent attempt to reopen a crucial grain corridor, Reuters reports. Kyiv is said to have made the offer through a third party. Moscow had yet to respond, the news agency added on Thursday. Since July, Ukrainian attacks have effectively closed the route for commercial Russian shipping, hitting nearly 220 vessels in the Sea of Azov and Black Sea, including oil tankers, grain cargo ships and passenger ferries, write Luke Harding and Andrew Roth . Russia on Thursday struck Ukraine’s port of Izmail, in the Odesa region near ⁠the Romanian border. Ukrainian drones struck the major Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat refinery in Bashkortostan deep inside Russia. It is one of Russia’s biggest refineries and lies south-east of Moscow about 1,300km (800 miles) from Ukraine’s border. Wildberries – the Russian online retailer targeted by Ukrainian drones for its sale of war supplies and its economic importance – said the Salavat attack also started a fire at one of its facilities. Russia and Ukraine swapped bodies of killed soldiers on Thursday . Kyiv has previously accused Russia of handing over the remains of civilians and Russian soldiers – fuelling suspicions Moscow manipulates the exchanges to make it look like more Ukrainians are dying than Russians, which is the opposite of independent assessments . “The bodies of 261 deceased persons have been returned to Ukraine, which, according to the Russian side, belong to Ukrainian servicemen,” said Ukraine’s prisoners of war agency. Citing a Russian lawmaker, the RBC media outlet said Moscow had handed over 261 bodies while Ukraine had transferred 24. Ukraine has condemned the illegality of Russian parliament ⁠elections next month in occupied areas . The foreign ministry statement ​coincided with the start ‌of a mission of ‌observers from ex-Soviet states to watch the election process. The foreign ministry in Kyiv said the presence of the observers made no difference : “Any vote organised by Russia on the sovereign territory of Ukraine is illegal and the results of such a vote are null and void and ‌have no legal consequences.” Explore more on these topics Ukraine Russia-Ukraine war at a glance Russia Europe explainers Share Reuse this content Most viewed Most viewed World Europe US news Americas Asia Australia Middle East Africa Inequality Global development

http://www.thejewishstar.com/stories/ros.text: Wednesday, September 23, 2026 Complete forecast Rosh Hashana reflections on divine kingship This period of the year demands two kinds of spiritual commitment. The first is charatah, regret: an honest inner search of our past year’s behavior, especially conduct that was sinful, immoral, inconsiderate, evil, or cruel. The second is teshuva , repentance — a sobering, if frightening, experience, for sure. Besides feeling regretful, we must commit to abandon such practices from this day forward. That. As I grow older, however, I have become aware of a different type of regret. It is not regret for missed behavior. It is regret for missed opportunities. Chief among them was my failure to draw closer to the great rabbinic figures of my youth, particularly Rabbi Joseph B. Soloveitchik (the Rav) and Rabbi Menachem Mendel Schneerson (the Rebbe), both of blessed memory. I was never a direct student of the former, although I did attend quite a few of his public lectures. Of the latter, I had even less exposure, even though, in the early years of my marriage, I resided within walking distance of his home and synagogue headquarters. As readers of my weekly columns, you may have noticed that I have tried to rectify my missed opportunity by studying their works, reading their biographies, and befriending some of their most prominent students. • • • Both giants stressed another aspect of the upcoming days, beginning with Rosh Hashana. It is the concept of MalchutShamayim (the Kingship of the Almighty). This concept is aptly explained in Rabbi Dr. Aaron Rakeffet-Rothkoff’s two-volume biography of Rav Soloveitchik, entitled “The Rav: The World of Rabbi Joseph B. Soloveitchik”: Rabbi Joseph Soloveitchik, doyen of Jewish thinkers in the 20th century, used to explain this by telling the story of his first Hebrew teacher, a Chabad Chasid who made an indelible impression on him as a child by telling him that Rosh Hashana was G-d’s coronation. “And who puts the crown on His head? We do.” He spoke about his memories of praying as a child among the Chasidim on the first night of Rosh Hashana: “I can feel the unique atmosphere which enveloped these Chasidim as they recited the prayers by which they proclaimed Him their King. The older Chasidim termed this night the “Coronation Night.” These poor and downtrodden Jews … were able to experience the enthroning of the Almighty and the true meaning of the Kingship prayers of the Rosh Hashana liturgy. The Shofar on Rosh Hashana is our way of participating in G-d’s coronation. As one born and bred in the United States of America, taught the values of democracy from kindergarten, I have always found it difficult to accept Kingship as a metaphor for the Ribbono shel Olam, the Master of the Universe. The kings that I read about in world history were rarely models of competence, let alone morality and beneficence. Similarly, the presidents of the United States, with perhaps a few exceptions, were hardly exemplary individuals. Even the current president, who occasionally asserts royal powers, is met by masses who cry out, “No Kings!” • • • The Lubavitcher Rebbe, who had a long and deep connection with the Rav, developed a conception of Kingship much more appropriate to the Ribbono shel Olam . For one version of his approach, I will introduce you to his profound mystical, spiritual, Chassidish definition of divine Kingship. It is to be found in his commentary on Pirkei Avot chapter 3, paragraph 2. It reads: Rabbi Chanina, the deputy High Priest, said: Pray for the welfare (shalom) of the government (malchut, or Kingship), for were it not for fear of it, people would swallow one another alive. The Rebbe is troubled (as are numerous other commentators, including the Maharal of Prague) by the phrase “would swallow one another alive.” Why not simply, “would kill each other”? The Rebbe is also troubled by the fact that the theme of Ethics of the Fathers is ethics, piety, and religious service. Why is Rabbi Chanina preaching political strategy? He explains that “swallow one another alive” does not describe a physical act. Rather, it captures the dynamic between an arrogant, powerful person and someone he sees as inferior—someone he feels entitled to demean at will. A king need not kill his subject; he can simply reduce him to fodder. The Rebbe chooses to adopt a completely different interpretation of Rabbi Chanina’s teaching. It is the interpretation of the medieval rabbinic sage, Ritva, as quoted in the compilation known as Midrash Shmuel . • • • Ritva explains that “pray for the welfare, or shalom , of the government — malchut , or king” means praying for the shalom of the heavenly attribute of divine Kingship. It is a call to ask the Almighty to intervene in worldly matters of war and peace. The “inner” meaning, insists the Rebbe, is incorporated in this verse in Kohelet (Ecclesiastes) chapter 5, verse 7: “If you see in a province oppression of the poor and suppression of right and justice, don’t wonder at the fact; for one high official is protected by a higher one, and both of them by a still higher one.” The “kings” whom we tend to fear are ultimately subject to a Higher Authority, to the Master of the Universe, the Ribbono shel Olam . Only He can thwart the schemes of those who would “swallow us alive.” Lord Acton knew that if power corrupts, then absolute power corrupts absolutely. Ritva, the Rebbe, and surely the Rav as well, knew that the “absolutely” powerful are subject to the One with Absolute Power, the King whom we coronate on Rosh Hashana. Oseh shalom bimromav (may He who makes peace in His high places) Hu berachamav ya’aseh shalom aleinu (in His compassion make peace for us and all Israel) V’imru amen (and say: Amen). https://www.portfolio.hu/global/20261111.text: Az ukrán tárgyalódelegáció egyik vezetője szerint az abu-dzabi találkozó lendületet adott a folyamatnak, így még az év vége előtt megszülethet a megoldás. A Reuters tudósítása szerint David Arahamija – aki Volodimir Zelenszkij szoros szövetségese és az elnök parlamenti frakciójának vezetője – ugyanakkor hangsúlyozta, hogy a háromoldalú formátum helyett szélesebb körű tárgyalásokra lenne szükség, amelyeken Európának is képviseltetnie kellene magát. A politikus az Ukrajinszka Pravda hírportál beszámolója szerint az eddigi egyik legnehezebb tárgyalási fordulónak nevezte a most tartott megbeszéléseket. Úgy gondolom, hogy az oroszok nagyon-nagyon szigorú utasításokkal érkeztek, és nehéz volt enyhíteni a vita hangnemét. Az azonban, ahogyan az amerikai képviselők a mindkét ország háború utáni helyzetének szemszögéből strukturálták a tárgyalásokat, véleményem szerint megnyitotta a párbeszédet, és produktívabb munkába kezdtünk - jelentette ki az amerikai és az ukrán küldöttségnek a tárgyalásokat követő közös sajtótájékoztatóján. A diplomáciai egyeztetések legkonkrétabb eredményeként Oroszország és Ukrajna megállapodott egy újabb nagyszabású fogolycseréről. Alekszandr Zorin orosz altábornagy tájékoztatása szerint a következő két-három hétben megvalósuló csere keretében mindkét oldalról több mint ezer hadifogoly térhet haza. Korábban Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán elnök is egy ezer-ezer, esetleg 1500-1500 fős fogolycserét helyezett kilátásba. Vlagyimir Megyinszkij orosz elnöki tanácsadó a tárgyalások légkörét jószándékúnak és gyakorlatiasnak minősítette, helyesnek nevezte a konfliktus lezárását követően létrehozandó európai biztonsági rendszer kérdésének felvetését. Mint mondta, a konfliktus rávilágított arra, hogy a jelenlegi rendszer nem működik megfelelően. Elmondása szerint az amerikai féllel bizonyos pontokban sikerült közös nevezőre jutniuk, más kérdésekben viszont maradtak nézeteltérések, így a párbeszéd folytatódni fog. Megyinszkij bejelentette, hogy az orosz fél nem tárgyalt az Európai Unió képviselőivel Abu-Dzabiban. Nem igazán értjük, milyen minőségben tartózkodnak itt. A tárgyalások a korábbi jóváhagyás értelmében háromoldalú jellegűek - mondta. Megyinszkij szerint Moszkva kész lenne megfontolni az európaiak konkrét javaslatait, ha kapna ilyeneket, eddig azonban nem érkezett békekezdeményezés az európai országoktól. "Ami egy sor európai ország vezetésének álláspontját illeti: ők lényegében az ukrán nép csoportos félrevezetésével foglalkoznak. Finanszírozzák és fegyverrel látják el az egyik harcoló felet, miközben lényegében hozzájárulnak a békés lakosság tömeges pusztulásához. Ezért nem igazán értjük, miről lehetne velük tárgyalni" - vélekedettt az orosz küldöttség vezetője. Megyinszkij háláját fejezte ki Steve Witkoff és Jared Kushner amerikai közvetítőknek, akiket példaként állított az európaiak elé a béke elérése iránti elkötelezettség terén. Az európai országok akkor válhatnak az ukrajnai béketárgyalások résztvevőivé, amikor felébred bennük a lelkiismeret - fogalmazott Megyinszkij. Hozzátette, az európai politikusok tanulhatnának az amerikai küldöttektől a józan ész, a realizmus és a békevágy terén. Megyinszkij szavaival némileg ellentétes, hogy a Kreml szerdai közlése szerint Vlagyimir Putyin orosz elnök nyitott a kapcsolatfelvételre az Európai Unióval, beleértve Friedrich Merz német kancellárt is. Arra a kérdésre válaszolva, hogy a tárgyalások során szóba került-e a területi kérdés, kijelentette: Minden talpalatnyi földünk visszatér Oroszországhoz. Így vagy úgy. Mint mondta, a tárgyalási folyamat konkrét részleteit az orosz fél nem hozza nyilvánosságra, amíg végleges megállapodásokra nem jutnak. Szergej Rjabkov külügyminiszter-helyettes, az orosz küldöttség tagja azt hangoztatta, hogy "elvileg van alapja a további munkának". Jared Kushner, az amerikai elnök veje és megbízottja Abu-Dzabiban bejelentette, hogy csütörtökön Moszkvába, majd onnan Kijeve utazik, hogy tárgyaljon a két ország államfőjével. Jurij Usakov , az orosz elnök külpolitikai tanácsadója megerősítette, hogy Putyin hamarosan fogadja Kushnert. A TASZSZ orosz állami hírügynökség szerdai értesülései szerint Kushner mellett Steve Witkoff is az orosz fővárosba veheti az irányt, ám a látogatás pontos időpontjáról és céljáról egyelőre nem közöltek részleteket. Csapdába csalja a fiatalokat az új technológia: a házi feladatot segíti, a vizsgákon mégis bukást hozhat. Rendkívüli közgyűlés is lesz decemberben. A Nemzeti Vagyonvisszaszerzési és Vagyonvédelmi Hivatal erős állításokat tett. Varga-Bajusz Veronika korábbi államtitkár sem járt jobban. A magyar katonák külföldi szerepvállalása is napirendre kerül. Christine Lagarde távozása és az európai jegybanki vezetőváltások ráirányítják a figyelmet az EU jövőjét alakító személyi és politikai döntésekre. https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/externe/schi.text: Un program instalat pe serverul de e-mail al unei organizații guvernamentale din România căuta corespondență cu adrese instituționale NATO și UE. Anunțul a venit din partea unei companii private, străine, de securitate cibernetică, ESET. Lucrurile se întâmplau încă din 23 decembrie 2025. Serviciul Român de Informații (SRI) a transmis miercuri un comunicat de presă pe această temă. ACTUALIZARE 12:50 Serviciul Român de Informații susține, într-un comunicat, că SRI, prin Centrul Național Cyberint, a identificat acest atac cibernetic în decembrie 2025 și a implementat măsuri de contracarare a acestuia și de remediere a efectelor sale. „Atacatorii au exploatat o serie de vulnerabilități sistemice la nivelul sistemelor de operare Microsoft, însă în urma intervenției Centrului Național Cyberint atacul a fost oprit. Nu au fost identificate exfiltrări de date sensibile, serviciul de e-mail afectat fiind remediat. De asemenea, SRI a informat beneficiarii legali și, totodată, aspectele respective au făcut obiectul cooperării cu partenerii europeni, la nivelul comunității de intelligence, precum și cu cei de la nivelul UE și NATO”, se mai spune în comunicatul SRI. „SRI/ Centrul National Cyberint are în derulare măsuri investigative complexe care vizează și alte secvențe conexate cu campanii cibernetice implementate de Federația Rusă. SRI/ Centrul Național Cyberint va continua să acționeze constant pentru identificarea și investigarea oricăror noi tentative de compromitere a instituțiilor din plan național”, continuă comunicatul. O organizație guvernamentală din România avea un sistem de e-mail compromis cel puțin din 23 decembrie 2025, potrivit analizei ESET Research publicate la 10 noiembrie 2026. Programul identificat pe server căuta mesaje trimise către sau primite de la adrese instituționale NATO și UE. Constatarea privește corespondența aflată în sistemul românesc; analiza nu descrie compromiterea sistemelor NATO sau ale UE. Setarile tale privind cookie-urile nu permit afisarea continutul din aceasta sectiune. Poti actualiza setarile modulelor coookie direct din browser sau de aici – e nevoie sa accepti cookie-urile social media ESET Research nu numește organizația din România. Cercetătorii au stabilit că sistemul era compromis cel puțin din 23 decembrie 2025 și că activitatea atacatorilor a crescut la 20 ianuarie 2026. Același set de instrumente fusese detectat la o organizație guvernamentală din Kazahstan la 28 noiembrie 2025, scrie cybersecuritynews.com . Componenta numită CerealBox funcționa în Microsoft Exchange și era configurată să identifice mesaje schimbate cu adrese din domeniile nato.int și europa.eu. Lista urmărită cuprindea și un număr mic de persoane aparent implicate în activități guvernamentale legate de NATO și UE. Programul verifica mesaje cu atașamente.doc,.docx sau.pdf, folosind criterii precum expeditorul, destinatarul, subiectul și numele fișierului. Potrivit descrierii tehnice ESET Research / WeLiveSecurity , mesajele selectate puteau fi comprimate, criptate și pregătite pe server pentru preluare. Cercetătorii descriu și comenzi prin care operatorii puteau citi și șterge acele fișiere. Nu au publicat însă o dovadă că mesaje din cazul românesc au fost transferate în afara rețelei și nici un număr al mesajelor selectate sau copiate. ESET Research atribuie activitatea grupării Turla, cu un grad ridicat de încredere, invocând folosirea unei componente atribuite anterior grupării și asemănarea cu un program asociat acesteia într-un raport din 2017. ESET arată și că Turla, cunoscută sub numele Snake, este considerată pe scară largă parte a FSB. Analiza nu identifică public persoanele care au operat programul în România. Cercetătorii nu au putut stabili cum a fost obținut accesul inițial. Exploatarea unei vulnerabilități este prezentată doar ca posibilitate. ESET Research nu a identificat nici adresele IP de la care operatorii au accesat serverul. Un articol anterior publicat de Cybersecuritynews.com despre colaborarea dintre Turla și Gamaredon descria o altă cale de spionaj pe termen lung, în care Gamaredon asigura accesul înainte ca Turla să-și implementeze backdoor-ul Kazuar, scrie cybersecuritynews.com. Cercetătorii nu au putut stabili cum au pătruns inițial atacatorii în niciuna dintre cele două organizații. Deși serverele Exchange erau conectate la internet, exploatarea unei vulnerabilități software rămâne doar o posibilitate. Constatările nu identifică o vulnerabilitate specifică, o campanie de phishing sau un cont furat ca punct de intrare. Această distincție este importantă deoarece Cereal descrie activitatea ulterioară compromiterii, nu o nouă metodă confirmată de pătrundere în Exchange. Cereal își trage numele de la „serializare”, un proces de împachetare a datelor unui program astfel încât acesta să poată fi reconstituit ulterior. Componentele sale utilizează această abordare pentru a transporta programe .NET criptate, a le despacheta și a le rula în memorie. Urmărește știrile Digi24.ro și pe Google News
